description:
Responsibilities: Brokerage platform development -- front and/or back-end, depending on experience. Front end: Java Swing. End-user facing trading platform. Back end: Core Java. XML. Qualifications: Bachelor’s in EE, CS, Math, Physics or similar (Masters/PhD a plus). Technically oriented, proactive, and enthusiastic, with extreme attention to detail. 0-3 years' Java experience. Knowledge of core Java. Knowledge of Java Swing and/or strong desire to learn Java Swing. 


 Java, XML, Java Swing
